title: CreateRelationshipInput
description: Input for creating a content edge (POST /db/relationships, POST /db/relationships/bulk items). Must match Rust CreateRelationshipInputView (crates/elohim-views/src/imagodei.rs). Source of truth: an authored edge's truth is its SOURCE atom's signed entry (Content.metadata_json relationships[], F16); storage projects each peer's relationships table from the adopted head. This direct write is seeder scaffold, retired once every atom states its edges in its entry.

id.description: Deterministic edge id: 'rel-' + first 32 hex of sha256(source|type|target). Omitted: storage mints one.

sourceId.description: The atom that authored the edge

inferenceSource.description: How the edge came to be; authored edges are 'explicit'

reach.description: The SOURCE atom's reach: an edge is never more open than the atom that authored it. Absent: a new edge is written at commons and an existing edge keeps its stored reach.

metadata.description: Edge metadata, stored as metadata_json. Carries the authored role.

role.description: The authored role (anchor, supporting, story, practice, callback, related, ...)
